NoncommutativeAndEquivariantIwasawa.summary: Neither library contains any noncommutative Iwasawa theory. The available inputs are generic: Mathlib's Ore localization with its universal property and injectivity for non-zero-divisor denominators, Noetherianity of commutative power-series rings, characters of finite-group representations and continuous group cohomology, and Tau Ceti's pro-p groups, K₀ of exact, abelian and triangulated categories, low-degree continuous cohomology with Shapiro's lemma, and the reduced norm of quaternion algebras only. Everything specific is missing: completed group rings of p-adic Lie groups and their noetherianity, the canonical Ore set and S-torsion categories, K₁ and relative K₀ with the localization sequence, characteristic elements, reduced norms and SK₁, Artin evaluation, equivariant Iwasawa complexes, zeta elements, the Kakde and Ritter–Weiss theorems and leading-term descent. NE.0 duplicates PadicMeasuresIwasawaAlgebras L1, NE.4 overlaps IntegralIwasawaTheory I.8 and NE.5 overlaps PeriodsAndSpecialValues PS.5.

targets.target: O[[G]] as the inverse limit over open normal subgroups and coefficient quotients, with its topology and continuous module actions
targets.note: No completed group ring exists in either library; for G = ℤ_p only the ℤ_p-linear identification of measures with ℤ_p⟦X⟧ is available.

targets.target: Restriction/induction and augmentation for O[[G]]
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Noetherian and module-finiteness facts for H ◁ G with G/H ≅ ℤ_p under the exact group hypotheses (Lazard/Venjakob)
targets.note: Only Noetherianity of commutative power-series rings is available; compact p-adic Lie groups and their Iwasawa algebras are absent.

targets.target: Acceptance: O[[ℤ_p]] ≅ O[[T]] and finite-level group rings of a concrete nonabelian quotient
targets.note: Finite group rings exist as MonoidAlgebra, but the ring isomorphism with O[[T]] does not.

targets.target: Separate hypotheses: absence of p-torsion, torsion-freeness and pro-p for compact p-adic Lie groups
targets.note: Pro-p groups (every open normal quotient a p-group) and p-groups are defined; compact p-adic Lie groups are not.

duplicates.note: Constructs R[[G]] = lim (R/I^n)[G/U] for all profinite G, with augmentation, restriction/induction and the continuous-action universal property.
Builds completedGroupAlgebra p Γ = lim_U ℤ_p[Γ/U] with functoriality and the power-series coordinate for Γ ≅ ℤ_p.

targets.target: The canonical Ore set S relative to H and its p-saturated variant S*
targets.note: Not defined; it depends on completed group rings, which do not exist.

targets.target: Both Ore conditions for S and S*, with denominator regularity where used
targets.note: The CFKSV Ore theorem is absent.

targets.target: Ore localization Λ_S and its universal localization property, given an Ore set
targets.note: Mathlib constructs R[S⁻¹] for any left Ore set of a (noncommutative) ring, with the ring structure, the universal ring homomorphism and its uniqueness, and injectivity of R → R[S⁻¹] when S consists of left non-zero-divisors.

targets.target: The category of S-torsion modules and perfect complexes, with the finiteness criterion over O[[H]]
targets.note: Not present; the cyclic-quotient and nonabelian acceptance examples are also absent.

targets.target: Localization boundary K₁(Λ_S) → K₀(Λ, Λ_S) with the exact localization sequence, functoriality and a fixed sign convention
targets.note: Neither library defines K₁ of a ring or relative K₀; Tau Ceti only has K₀ of exact, abelian and triangulated categories.

targets.target: Classes of perfect S-torsion complexes in relative K₀, additive for exact sequences and mapping cones
targets.note: Additivity on distinguished triangles exists for triangulated K₀, but not for relative K₀ of a localization.

targets.target: Characteristic elements as lifts of a relative class, with ambiguity exactly the image of K₁(Λ)
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Acceptance: for a commutative one-variable cyclic torsion module, recovery of its characteristic power series up to units
targets.note: Characteristic power series are not defined either (see PadicMeasuresIwasawaAlgebras L4).

duplicates.note: Defines relative K-theory as a homotopy fibre, including support K-theory for a localisation A → S⁻¹A, of which the relative K₀(Λ,Λ_S) and its boundary here are an instance (NE.2 cites it as input).

targets.target: Twisting and evaluation of localized K₁ at continuous finite-dimensional Artin representations, where the localized map exists
targets.note: Characters of representations exist; K₁ evaluation maps do not.

targets.target: Reduced norms on the semisimple total quotient algebra and SK₁ as their kernel
targets.note: Only the reduced norm of a quaternion algebra, as a quadratic form, is defined; reduced norms of general semisimple algebras and SK₁ are absent.

targets.target: Functoriality under coefficient extension, and what character evaluations determine (the surviving SK₁ ambiguity)
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Compactly supported and Iwasawa Galois cohomology complexes with G-action and local conditions
targets.note: Continuous group cohomology exists, but not compactly supported or Iwasawa complexes.

targets.target: Derived induction and restriction for these complexes
targets.note: Tau Ceti proves Shapiro's lemma for coinduced discrete modules in degrees 0 and 1 only.

targets.target: Perfectness and S-torsion of the complexes under the selected ramification and cohomological hypotheses
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Archimedean terms and duality tracked before assigning relative K₀ classes
targets.note: No Poitou–Tate duality in either library.

targets.target: Acceptance: specialization to a cyclotomic abelian extension recovering the existing arithmetic complex
targets.note: The commutative complex is also absent.

duplicates.note: Constructs the compactly supported Iwasawa complex RΓ_c(O_{F∞,S}, ℤ_p(1)) with perfectness and derived inverse-limit description, the abelian case this layer specializes to.

targets.target: A localized-K₁ zeta element with boundary and Artin-interpolation properties (periods, local factors, exceptional zeros)
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Norm, restriction and abelianization maps on K₁ and agreement with commutative determinant formulas
targets.note: K₁ is not defined.

targets.target: Acceptance: an abelian specialization recovering the normalized p-adic L-function and arithmetic determinant
targets.note: Not present.

duplicates.note: Formulates zeta-element and equivariant Tamagawa-number statements in relative K-groups and requires commutative specializations to recover the determinant formula.

targets.target: Kakde and Ritter–Weiss proofs: integral logarithms and congruences, abelian pseudomeasures, noncommutative patching and the localization boundary calculation
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Main conjectures for totally real p-adic Lie extensions with their odd-prime, admissibility and μ = 0 hypotheses, recorded source by source
targets.note: Not present; the requested coverage table is bookkeeping around these theorems.

targets.target: Newer unconditional abelian results via explicit comparison maps, and a separate function-field route
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Derived specialization and Bockstein/regulator data defining leading terms where evaluations vanish
targets.note: No Bockstein maps or leading-term constructions in either library.

targets.target: Descent identities under semisimplicity/finiteness hypotheses and the relative K-theory statement exported to special values
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Exceptional zeros and noncommutative Fitting invariants with their orders and denominator ideals
targets.note: Fitting invariants are not defined.

PadicMeasuresIwasawaAlgebras.summary: Mathlib already supplies the bounded-measure foundations with ℤ_p coefficients: abstract measures D(X,R) = C(X,R) →L[R] R with Dirac measures, pushforward and a Fubini interchange for profinite spaces, clopen-partition approximation on any profinite space, Mahler's theorem, the ℤ_p-linear Amice transform D(ℤ_p,ℤ_p) ≃ ℤ_p⟦X⟧, Banach–Alaoglu over p-adic fields, and Weierstrass division and preparation with uniqueness over any complete local ring, with O⟦T⟧ Noetherian and factorial and O[T]/(f) ≅ O⟦T⟧/(g) finite free. Tau Ceti adds uniformizer-normalized valuations of local fields and primitive central idempotents of group algebras over algebraically closed fields. Genuinely missing: completed group rings and the convolution algebra, the Amice transform over general O and as an algebra map, φ/ψ and the rest of RJW §3.5, pseudo-measures, rigid weight spaces, the Λ-module structure theorem with characteristic and Fitting ideals and μ/λ, determinant lines, topological Nakayama, and Gorenstein orders with exact duality. L0a duplicates LocallyAnalyticDistributions L3, and L1 duplicates NoncommutativeAndEquivariantIwasawa NE.0 and the completed-group-algebra package of ProfiniteProPGroups Layer 9.

targets.target: Continuous scalar extension along isometric embeddings of p-adic fields (of C(X,K), Banach spaces and measures)
targets.note: Neither library has an extension-of-scalars map for AbstractMeasure or for p-adic Banach spaces along K → L.

targets.target: Finite free integral lattices in finite-dimensional K-vector spaces
targets.note: Lattices are finitely generated R-submodules spanning V; over a PID (e.g. O) they are free of rank dim_K V.

targets.target: Relation between the normalized valuation v_p and a uniformizer valuation v_ϖ (v_ϖ = e·v_p)
targets.note: Mathlib proves v(x)^e = w(x) for x in K along an extension of Dedekind domains, and Tau Ceti defines the ℤ-valued uniformizer valuation of a local field (equal to v_p on ℚ_p). A ℚ-valued v_p on a finite extension and the formula v_p = v_ϖ/e there are not stated.

targets.target: Completed tensor products of p-adic Banach spaces/modules
targets.note: No completed (projective) tensor product exists in either library; Tau Ceti's Huber base-change results only treat restricted power series.

targets.target: K-valued bounded measures on a profinite X as the continuous K-linear dual of C(X,K), with its operator norm
targets.note: AbstractMeasure X R E := C(X,R) →L[R] E for any topological ring R; for a normed field K continuity is boundedness. The strong topology is only a definition, with completeness coming from the general space of continuous linear maps.

targets.target: The integral lattice of measures taking C(X,O) into O: its description, boundedness and scaling into it
targets.note: D(X,ℤ_[p]) can be formed directly, but its identification with the unit ball of D(X,ℚ_p) and the scaling statement are not proved.

targets.target: Density of locally constant functions in C(X,K) via finite clopen partitions, for an arbitrary profinite X
targets.note: For compact Hausdorff totally disconnected X, every continuous f is approximated within any neighbourhood of the diagonal by a finite sum of clopen indicators (the additive form is exists_finite_sum_const_indicator_approximation_of_mem_nhds_diagonal); stated as approximation rather than as Dense.

targets.target: Integral measures ≅ finitely additive O-valued functions on clopens; K-valued measures ≅ bounded such functions
targets.note: Mathlib's AddContent gives G-valued finitely additive set functions on a family of sets, but no comparison with abstract measures on clopens exists.

targets.target: Extension of measures from dense test-function spaces, and uniqueness
targets.note: General extension along dense uniform embeddings into a complete target and uniqueness from a dense span; nothing measure-specific is needed.

targets.target: Operations on measures: scalar extension, pushforward, restriction to a clopen, extension by zero, support and disjoint decomposition
targets.note: Pushforward along continuous maps (with map_map, map_dirac) exists; restriction to and extension by zero from clopens, support, disjoint decomposition and scalar extension are missing.

targets.target: Orthonormal-basis theorem for p-adic Banach spaces with norm values in |K^×| (lifting a basis of the lattice modulo ϖ)
targets.note: Only the Mahler basis of C(ℤ_p,E), an isometry with c₀(ℕ,E), is available; the general theorem of RJW Remark 3.4 is missing.

targets.target: Operator-norm and weak topologies on the dual, completeness, weak compactness of the integral dual and non-compactness in norm
targets.note: Both topologies are defined (not as instances) and Banach–Alaoglu holds over any proper nontrivially normed field, which covers finite extensions of ℚ_p; the identification of the unit ball with integral measures, completeness statements for these topologies, and the non-compactness example are missing.

targets.target: Rigid analytic space representing continuous characters G → A^× on affinoid algebras, for compact abelian p-adic analytic G, with its universal character
targets.note: For G = ℤ_p Mathlib identifies continuous characters valued in a complete ultrametric normed ℤ_p-algebra with its topologically nilpotent elements (the open unit disc on points); there is no rigid space, representability or general G.

targets.target: Generic-fibre construction from the completed group ring, finite-character components, polydisc charts, pullback in G and affinoid base change, with the separate p = 2 chart
targets.note: Tau Ceti has only closed polydiscs as adic spectra of restricted power series rings; open discs, weight spaces and their charts are absent.

targets.target: Separate domains of integral, rigid and locally analytic characters; factorization through the abelianization for nonabelian G
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Analytic universal-character action on distribution/coefficient modules with radii, continuity and completed coefficient tensors
targets.note: Depends on locally analytic distributions and completed tensors, neither of which exists.

duplicates.note: Also constructs the functor of continuous characters of a compact commutative p-adic analytic group on affinoid algebras, the polydisc identification for ℤ_p^d, the p = 2 components, the universal character and the adic/rigid character spaces.

targets.target: R[[G]] = lim_(n,U) (R/I^n)[G/U] for a complete adic ring R and profinite G, with its topology
targets.note: No completed group ring exists in either library; for G = ℤ_p Mathlib only has the ℤ_p-linear identification of D(ℤ_p,ℤ_p) with ℤ_p⟦X⟧.

targets.target: Independence of the ideal of definition, functoriality, augmentation, Dirac elements and density of R[G]
targets.note: Dirac measures exist for abstract measures but not in a completed group ring.

targets.target: Universal property for continuous actions on complete separated linearly topologized modules with open G-stable submodules
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: For R = O, the presentation O[[G]] = lim_U O[G/U]
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Convolution by iterated integration and the interchange theorem (first on locally constant functions, then by uniform approximation)
targets.note: Mathlib proves that the two iterated integrals of a function on X × Y agree for profinite X, Y, via density of C(X,R) ⊗ C(Y,R); the convolution product (pushforward along multiplication) and the resulting algebra structure on measures are not defined.

targets.target: Topological O-algebra isomorphism between integral measures and O[[G]], noncommutative in general and commutative for abelian G
targets.note: Missing; the only comparison is the linear Amice equivalence for G = ℤ_p and O = ℤ_p.

targets.target: Restriction/induction and finite-index norm maps on completed group rings, with projection formulas
targets.note: Not present for completed group rings.

targets.target: The inclusion of measures on ℤ_p^× into measures on ℤ_p is linear but not multiplicative for the two convolutions
targets.note: Pushforward along the inclusion exists; the convolution structures needed for the statement do not.

duplicates.note: Constructs O[[G]] again as the inverse limit over open normal subgroups and coefficient quotients, with its topology, continuous module actions, restriction/induction and augmentation.
Builds completedGroupAlgebra p Γ = lim_U ℤ_p[Γ/U] as a compact topological ℤ_p-algebra with functoriality, finite-level projections, compact modules and the power-series coordinate.

targets.target: Mahler's theorem with the coefficient-general Mahler basis and its norm formula
targets.note: Mahler series converge to f for E a complete ultrametric normed ℤ_p-module, and f ↦ (Δ^n f(0)) is an isometric equivalence C(ℤ_p,E) ≃ c₀(ℕ,E).

targets.target: Amice transform M(ℤ_p,O) ≅ O⟦T⟧, A_μ(T) = Σ μ(binom(x,n)) T^n, with the inverse obtained by summing Mahler coefficients
targets.note: The transform is defined for any topological ℤ_p-algebra of coefficients, but the equivalence with its inverse is proved only for O = ℤ_p (general coefficients are a TODO in the file).

targets.target: Multiplicativity for convolution, Dirac transforms, coefficient extraction, injectivity and uniqueness from polynomial moments
targets.note: Coefficient extraction, injectivity (complete ultrametric normed coefficients) and determination by the values on binomial polynomials are proved; multiplicativity and the transform of Dirac measures are missing because convolution is not defined.

targets.target: Extension of the Mahler–Amice theory to ℤ_p^d
targets.note: Only one variable is treated.

targets.target: Coefficientwise (ϖ,T)-adic topology versus uniform convergence of coefficients
targets.note: The coefficientwise topology on power series and the weak/strong topologies on measures exist separately; no comparison through the Amice transform.

targets.target: RJW §3.5 operators: multiplication by a function, ∂ = (1+T)d/dT, translations, dilations, residue-class projections by roots of unity, φ(T) = (1+T)^p − 1, ψ, ψφ = 1, φψ = restriction to pℤ_p, restriction to units 1 − φψ, and inversion of x on units
targets.note: Only the formal derivative of power series and pushforward of measures exist; none of the operators is defined on measures or transported through the Amice transform.

duplicates.note: Builds the same restriction, twisting, φ, ψ, differentiation and division-by-x toolbox for distributions and its compatibility with the bounded Amice transform.
Constructs ψ as the normalized left inverse of φ with ψφ = 1 on the power-series coefficient rings and compares it with this layer's ψ.
Proves O[[T]] finite free over φ(O[[T]]) and identifies the normalized trace with ψ, overlapping this layer's construction of ψ.

targets.target: Total quotient ring of the commutative O[[G]] (localization at non-zero-divisors)
targets.note: The generic localization at non-zero-divisors exists, but the ring O[[G]] it should be applied to does not.

targets.target: Pseudo-measures λ with ([g] − 1)λ ∈ O[[G]] for all g: module structure and augmentation-ideal description
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Evaluation of pseudo-measures at nontrivial characters by clearing a factor [g] − 1, independent of g
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: For procyclic G: principal augmentation ideal, the existence/uniqueness statements of RJW §§3–4 and change of generator
targets.note: Not present; Tau Ceti's augmentation ideals are those of Hopf algebras and A∞-algebras, not of group rings.

targets.target: ℤ_2^× = {±1} × (1 + 4ℤ_2) treated as a non-procyclic group
targets.note: Tau Ceti has the unit filtration of a local field, but no product decomposition of ℤ_p^× or ℤ_2^×.

duplicates.note: Divides by [a] − 1 in the total quotient ring and proves regularity and independence of the smoothing parameter for the Kubota–Leopoldt pseudo-measure, a special case of this layer's evaluation theory.
Also constructs ℤ_p[[G∞]] with its total quotient ring for abelian extensions of a totally real field.

targets.target: Weierstrass division and preparation for O[[T]], with uniqueness
targets.note: Proved over any complete local ring (IsAdicComplete for the maximal ideal) for series whose reduction is nonzero; this covers any complete DVR O.

targets.target: Continuity of Weierstrass division
targets.note: Only additivity and scalar compatibility of the quotient and remainder are proved.

targets.target: O[[T]] is Noetherian and factorial
targets.note: Anonymous instances: R⟦X⟧ is Noetherian for Noetherian R and a UFD for a principal ideal domain R; both apply to a DVR O.

targets.target: O[[T]] is a regular local ring of Krull dimension two
targets.note: Only dim R + 1 ≤ dim R⟦X⟧ is proved, and regularity is only known for local PIDs; the equality dim O[[T]] = 2 and regularity are missing.

targets.target: Finite free remainders: O[[T]]/(g) ≅ O[T]/(f) for the distinguished polynomial f, free of rank deg f
targets.note: The algebra isomorphism A[X]/(f) ≃ A⟦X⟧/(g) together with freeness of the quotient by a monic polynomial gives the statement.

targets.target: Structure theorem: every finitely generated O[[T]]-module is pseudo-isomorphic to an elementary module; symmetry of pseudo-isomorphism for torsion modules
targets.note: No pseudo-isomorphisms or elementary modules in either library.

targets.target: Characteristic ideals from lengths at height-one primes, the elementary-divisor comparison, multiplicativity in exact sequences, pseudo-isomorphism invariance, cyclic modules, twisting, inversion, finite flat coefficient extension and change of generator
targets.note: Module lengths and orders of vanishing exist; characteristic ideals do not.

targets.target: μ- and λ-invariants (μ via v_ϖ) and the class-number growth normalization for O = ℤ_p
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Fitting ideals, and finite modules with unit characteristic ideal but non-unit Fitting ideal
targets.note: Fitting ideals of modules are not defined in either library.

targets.target: Integral character idempotents of O[Δ] for finite abelian Δ of order prime to p after adjoining character values, with componentwise comparisons
targets.note: Complete orthogonal primitive central idempotents exist only over algebraically closed fields with |G| invertible; character sums Σ χ(h)h with e² = |H|e hold over any commutative semiring. The integral version over O and the componentwise module comparisons are missing.

targets.target: Height-one divisors on O[[ℤ_p^d]]; pseudo-null means codimension at least two
targets.note: Only Noetherianity of power series in finitely many variables is available.

duplicates.note: Also proves finite-error stabilization under pseudo-isomorphisms and computes coinvariant orders of elementary modules.
Proves the division criterion (T − c) | ψ ⟺ ψ(c) = 0 in ℤ_p[[T]], a special case of this layer's Weierstrass division (general preparation is excluded there).

targets.target: Determinant lines of bounded complexes of finite projective modules, compatible with quasi-isomorphisms, exact triangles, duals and derived base change
targets.note: Invertible modules and top exterior powers of free modules exist; no determinant functor on complexes.

targets.target: Rational trivialization and the relation between its divisor and alternating characteristic divisors of torsion cohomology
targets.note: Not present.

targets.target: Perfect complexes and invertible modules as the carrier over non-regular coefficient rings
targets.note: No notion of perfect complex in either library.

targets.target: Exactness of inverse limits for the compact inverse systems used in arithmetic, via Mittag-Leffler or compactness
targets.note: Mathlib has Mittag-Leffler systems of types, nonempty limits of finite (and compact Hausdorff) cofiltered systems, and exactness of adic completion on finite modules over a Noetherian ring; exactness of limits of compact topological modules is not stated.

targets.target: Topological Nakayama for compact modules and finite generation from a finite residual quotient
targets.note: Only algebraic Nakayama for finitely generated modules is available.

targets.target: Specialization exact sequences with Tor terms and finite-error control for coinvariants
targets.note: Tor exists as a derived functor, without the specialization sequences.

duplicates.note: Also builds perfect complexes over complete local O-algebras with derived base change, the Tor specialization spectral sequence, derived Nakayama and derived Mittag–Leffler comparisons.
Constructs integral determinant lines of perfect complexes with invariance under quasi-isomorphism and finite-module corrections.
Proves compact (topological) Nakayama to deduce finite generation and torsion of Iwasawa modules.

targets.target: Commutative O-orders (finite torsion-free over a complete DVR) with semisimple fraction algebra, including semilocal products
targets.note: No carrier for orders over a DVR in either library.

targets.target: The O-dual Hom_O(R,O) as an R-module, and Gorenstein order ⟺ the dual is invertible (locally free of rank one)
targets.note: Tau Ceti proves the analogue over a field (a Frobenius functional exists iff A ≅ its k-dual); nothing for orders over O.

targets.target: For nonzero a ∈ O the quotient R/aR of a Gorenstein order is self-injective, while arbitrary quotients need not be
targets.note: Self-injectivity is proved only for algebras over a field carrying a perfect associative form; R/aR is an O/aO-algebra, not a field algebra.

targets.target: Exact R-dual on finite modules over zero-dimensional Gorenstein quotients: biduality, annihilator duality, length comparisons and compatibility with coefficient reduction
targets.note: No Matlis-type duality in either library.

targets.target: Hom_R(−,R), O-linear and derived duals of lattices over positive-dimensional orders, with change-of-rings maps
targets.note: Only the generic linear dual exists.

targets.target: Fitting ideals, projective presentations, exterior powers and exterior-bidual base-change/denominator lemmas
targets.note: Finite presentations and exterior powers exist; Fitting ideals and exterior biduals do not.

duplicates.note: Constructs exterior biduals with their base-change and coefficient-change hypotheses, overlapping this layer's exterior-bidual lemmas.
Also develops Fitting ideals of modules as a general tool.
